en: The postcard features a famous classical painting depicting a dramatic biblical scene. In the image, a richly dressed man wearing a turban, likely a king, turns in shock toward a glowing hand writing mysterious Hebrew letters on a dark wall. Several other figures appear alarmed or frightened. The setting is an opulent banquet table with food and goblets. The script on the wall is in Hebrew characters.
